# NEW 2026-11-22 v12.0 Worker 3 (Slot 95 oe_aip_): 6 Dynamic Historical AI Personalities & Global Eurasian Diplomatic/Expansion Choreography (0 vanilla overrides, 0 ai_diplochance). Generated by gen_v120_epic_ai.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Verified EU5 1.4.9 ai_scripted_expansion_score schema (complements oe_ai2_* & oe_majors_ai.txt; 0 key overlap).
# Every rule enforces oe_aip_ai_active = yes (Rule #18 active, is_ai = yes, is_rebel_country = no, is_subject = no).

# 1. European powers (pre-1750): deter absurd overland/inland invasions of Japan or Korea
oe_aip_score_euro_no_japan_korea_inland = {
	attacker_potential = {
		oe_aip_ai_active = yes
		current_year < 1750
		capital ?= { continent = continent:europe }
	}
	target_trigger = {
		NOT = { is_neighbor_of = scope:attacker }
		capital ?= {
			OR = {
				region = region:japan_region
				region = region:korea_region
			}
		}
	}
	multiplier = {
		add = -0.85
	}
	score = {
		add = -350
	}
}

oe_aip_score_china_no_india_siberia_bleed = {

			tag = MCH
		}

	target_trigger = {

		capital ?= {
			OR = {
				region = region:hindustan_region
				region = region:bengal_region
				region = region:east_siberia_region
			}
		}
	}
	multiplier = {
		add = -0.75
	}
	score = {
		add = -280
	}
}

# 4. Iranian Plateau powers: consolidate Persia before absurd distant overseas adventures
oe_aip_score_persia_no_overseas_gore = {
	attacker_potential = {
		oe_aip_ai_active = yes
		current_year < 1700
		OR = {
			tag = IRA
			tag = TIM
			tag = JAL
			tag = ABL
			tag = AQQ
			tag = QAR
		}
		OR = {
			num_locations < 40
			NOT = { owns = location:isfahan }
		}
	}
	target_trigger = {
		NOT = { is_neighbor_of = scope:attacker }
		capital ?= {
			OR = {
				sub_continent = sub_continent:western_europe
				region = region:indonesia_region
				region = region:japan_region
				continent = continent:america
				continent = continent:africa
			}
		}
	}
	multiplier = {
		add = -0.80
	}
	score = {
		add = -300
	}
}

# 5. Japanese clans: finish unifying Japan before launching premature overseas invasions
oe_aip_score_japan_finish_home_first = {
	attacker_potential = {
		oe_aip_ai_active = yes
		capital ?= { region = region:japan_region }
		OR = {
			num_locations < 70
			current_year < 1580
		}
	}
	target_trigger = {
		capital ?= {
			NOT = { region = region:japan_region }
		}
	}
	multiplier = {
		add = -0.85
	}
	score = {
		add = -350
	}
}

# 6. POR: focus on coastal trade hubs in South & SE Asia, avoid landlocked inland enclaves
oe_aip_score_por_coastal_focus_only = {
	attacker_potential = {
		oe_aip_ai_active = yes
		tag = POR
	}
	target_trigger = {
		has_ports = no
		capital ?= {
			OR = {
				sub_continent = sub_continent:south_asia
				sub_continent = sub_continent:south_east_asia
			}
		}
	}
	multiplier = {
		add = -0.75
	}
	score = {
		add = -280
	}
}

# 7. Eurasian Concert Restraint: Concert Pentarchy / treaty members curb peer aggression against fellow members
oe_aip_score_concert_truce_restraint = {
	attacker_potential = {
		oe_aip_ai_active = yes
		oe_aip_in_concert_sovereignty = yes
		NOT = { oe_heg2_is_multi_hegemon = yes }
	}
	target_trigger = {
		oe_aip_is_concert_member = yes
		NOT = { oe_heg2_is_multi_hegemon = yes }
	}
	multiplier = {
		add = -0.60
	}
	score = {
		add = -220
	}
}

		NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:attacker }
	}

		add = -0.50
	}
